s: Mexico (a country in North America, located south of the United States, and northwest of Guatemala and Belize from Central America)
Mexiko.et: Borrowed from Spanish México, from Classical Nahuatl Mēxihco.

s: a drink made of Korn (or wodka), Sangrita, tomato juice, and tabasco sauce; similar to a bloody mary, but spicier and served as a shot
Mexican (female person from Mexico or of Mexican descent)

mexikanisch.et: From Mexiko + -isch with -an- from -ānus and analogy.

s: Die Spanier wusten von Californiâ bereits von der Zeit an, da sie Mexicum erobert, und ihm den Namen von Neu-Spanien beygelegt haben.
